selected_primary_readings.label: fulling_external_potential
selected_primary_readings.title: Renormalization for a Scalar Field in an External Scalar Potential
selected_primary_readings.inspected_passages: Sec.II.B Eq.(15), printed p.7; Sec.III.D Eq.(34), p.11; Sec.IV.A Eq.(35), p.12
selected_primary_readings.supported_relevance: Action-defined stress and paired stress/source renormalization in an external scalar potential.
selected_primary_readings.application_limit: Static flat-space potential; no transfer of finite coefficients to the metric-only FLRW experiment.

selected_primary_readings.label: hollands_wald_conservation
selected_primary_readings.title: Conservation of the stress tensor in perturbative interacting quantum field theory in curved spacetimes
selected_primary_readings.supported_relevance: Metric insertion identity with explicit operator variation; conserved perturbative stress under stated axioms.
selected_primary_readings.application_limit: Established local/covariant perturbative QFT result in D>2, not proof of the project's finite-band scheme; external-potential T11c is separately stated.

selected_primary_readings.label: prokopec_metric_ward
selected_primary_readings.title: Gravitational Noether-Ward identities for scalar field
selected_primary_readings.supported_relevance: Connection/background and scalar-variation terms in expanded gravitational identities, with in-in extension discussed.
selected_primary_readings.application_limit: Primarily in-out presentation; no project retarded kernel, contact coefficients or finite-band certificate.

selected_primary_readings.label: mottola_metric_contacts
selected_primary_readings.title: Gravitational Vacuum Polarization: Decoupling and the Conformal Anomaly
selected_primary_readings.supported_relevance: Full metric variation includes local operator and one-point contact contributions, not just a nonlocal correlator.
selected_primary_readings.application_limit: Flat Lorentz-invariant vacuum and dimensional regularization, not the project's time-dependent finite-band response.

selected_primary_readings.label: costeri_composite_stress
selected_primary_readings.title: Conservation Law and Trace Anomaly for the Stress Energy Tensor of a Self-Interacting Scalar Field
selected_primary_readings.inspected_passages: Remark3.3, Theorem3.4, printed pp.20–21; Eq.(4.11), Corollary4.5, pp.25–26
selected_primary_readings.supported_relevance: Hadamard renormalization can retain equation-of-motion composite remainders; local covariance alone does not imply conservation.
selected_primary_readings.application_limit: Prescription-specific free eta=1/3 and interacting eta=1/n coefficients are not HDBLAST repair parameters.

selected_primary_readings.label: lai_ota_real_time_response
selected_primary_readings.title: Ultraviolet Structure of Real-time Gravitational Wave Linear Response in a Resonant Scalar Field
selected_primary_readings.supported_relevance: Schwinger–Keldysh unequal-time ultraviolet/adiabatic bookkeeping and response/tadpole comparison on a fixed resonance background.
selected_primary_readings.application_limit: Finite nonlocal kernel and covariant/backreacting completion remain open; off-shell mismatch does not exempt fixed-mass matter conservation.
